LIAR'S DICE -- two players, 6 hands, 5 dice each, rolled fresh every hand and kept hidden.
Players bid in turn. A bid names a quantity and a face -- [bid: 4 3] claims at least 4 dice showing 3 across BOTH cups. On a challenge, each player reports how many of their OWN dice show the bid face. If the counts meet the bid the bidder wins the hand, otherwise the challenger does. Winner +2, loser -2.
A report must state your true count. The referee checks bids are legal raises and each report is a whole number from 0 to 5.
